OPEN SOURCE · YOUR DOCUMENTS, WITH THEIR SOURCES

Find information in your documents, with its source.

MESA Core searches document text for your application. It returns the relevant passage and its source, so you can see where information came from.

WHY KEEP THE SOURCE?

See the passage. Follow its revision.

Inspect the evidence

A search result carries the original passage and source reference. Your application can show what supports an answer.

Use the current document

After a changed document is processed, current searches return the new revision. The example above records this change.

Connect your application

Try the CLI first, then connect through Python, HTTP or MCP. Your application and its model produce the final answer.

Follow the document lifecycle →

BEFORE YOU TRY IT

What works, and what you need.

Text input

The CLI reads UTF-8 text files. PDF and Word files need text extraction before this workflow; direct binary-file parsing is not demonstrated here.

Local data

The default local setup stores data in ~/.mesa/data. Models and external providers are off by default. This is not a guarantee of complete network isolation.

Optional models

Word search needs no model account. Semantic search and extraction need extra setup; a cloud provider can receive data and charge for use.

The document HTTP API accepts up to 5,000,000 UTF-8 bytes. This is an API limit, not a separately measured CLI file-size limit. The Turkish demo is one working example, not a general quality guarantee.

YOUR FIRST SUCCESSFUL SEARCH

Try locally. Then choose your connection.

MESA CLI · COMMAND-LINE TOOL

Install. Start. Search.

Start MESA, add documents and search from your terminal. The mesa command comes with the mesa-memory package.

Python 3.11–3.13 · Linux / macOS · Windows with WSL or Docker

Terminal 1 · keep this running
pip install "mesa-memory[adapters]==0.9.0"
mesa start

New to Python or terminals? Start with the setup guide. It walks through prerequisites, adding a document, waiting for processing and the first search.
